title: Work Journal backup: also back up when Maestro closes, and write a readable work-journal.md beside the JSON
story: Maestro now also writes the Work Journal backup when the main window closes, after the journal windows save; it waits at most 2 seconds and still closes if the backup fails. Each backup (daily, Back up now, or on close) now puts a readable work-journal.md next to work-journal.json in the backup folder. Before, the only backup was the JSON file, written daily or by hand, and nothing was backed up on close.

checks.criterion: Closing Maestro writes a backup when a backup folder is set; a failure is logged and does not block closing
checks.steps: Start Maestro with no terminals open. In Settings → Work Journal pick an empty made-up folder such as C:\qa-backup. Type 'QA close test' on today's page and close the main window. Repeat with the folder deleted before closing.
checks.expected: Maestro closes within about 2 seconds and both work-journal.json and work-journal.md hold 'QA close test'; with the folder deleted Maestro still closes and its log has a warning starting 'Work Journal backup on close not written'.

checks.criterion: Each backup writes both files; the Markdown lists pages newest first and shows cards readably
checks.steps: On two day pages add a typed card at 09:15 with text 'Made-up task' and a free note with one bold word. Press Back up now in Settings and open work-journal.md in Notepad.
checks.expected: The newer page's '## <date>' heading comes first; the card reads '**09:15** (typed) Made-up task' (with the project after the time if set); the bold word shows as '**word**'.

checks.steps: After a backup edit work-journal.md to say 'garbage', then run Restore from backup.
checks.expected: Restore uses the JSON: the pages come back unchanged and the edited Markdown has no effect.
